exact_statement: For every a>=1,b>=0,r>=1, let g=1-2 A_a on n=a+b data bits with b dummies, edit any full negative data point under r fresh uniform point controls, F=g+2 A_r D_n, and supply a normalized data reference R positive on source support with finite cost c. Put s=2^-a,t=2^-n,p=2^-r,rho=4pt,lambda=2p*2^-b,mu=1-2s; let R0 be the CE-nonincreasing empty calibration to mu^2. The actual data marginal is q=(1-lambda)P_g+lambda*mu*delta_empty+rho*U_n. The positive normalized floor Rprime=(1-lambda)R0+lambda*mu*delta_empty+rho*U_n and actual conditional control kernel give a complete normalized Q. Its exact residual KL is (1-lambda)D(P_g||R0)-kappa, where kappa is the measured posterior KL of this same three-component true/reference mixture. Exact physical charges are I_g=2as,C=2ptb,E=2pta,J=2rpt and I_F=I_g+C-E+J. The full ideal cost satisfies CE_F<=c+10(C+E+J). For any K>=10, K I_F-CE_F>=S_K+(K-10)C-(K+10)E+(K-10)J with S_K=K I_g-c. Since E<=I_g/2, a certified supplied source cost c<=C0 I_g yields CE_F<=(2C0+10)I_F, spending that source bank once. The structural source R=P_g obeys c<4I_g and hence yields complete CE_F<=18I_F. An independent arbitrary Boolean terminal h with full supplied R_h retains exact tensor CE=c_h+CE_F, KL=D_h+(1-lambda)D_gcal-kappa, and additive influence; conditional c_h<=C_h I_h yields max(C_h,2C0+10) total payment. This is a prescribed-reference/erased-edge transfer on a known read-once Boolean class, not a new FEI class claim, arbitrary-core floor theorem, or hereditary incoming-reference transport.
